draft.title: Neptune opposite North Node
draft.humanMoment: A food bank replaces one weekly parcel line with a pay-what-you-can market, drawing new shoppers and protests from longtime recipients who trusted the old routine.
draft.developmentDetail: Volunteers track which staples move and where queues form, while supporters still disagree about whether the market is meant to improve access, dignity, or financial stability.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Neptune carries the ideal and the uncertainty around its purpose, while the North Node presses the trial toward a direction that can be recognized through practice.
draft.aspectMechanic: The opposition places recipients defending the parcel line across from volunteers testing the market, so neither the old routine nor the emerging evidence can be removed from the outcome.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the market reduces queues but leaves staple access uneven, the food bank gains a clearer direction without settling every argument about what should have been preserved.

judge.weakest: Neptune carries the ideal and the uncertainty around its purpose, while the North Node presses the trial toward a direction that can be recognized through practice.
judge.why: All checks pass; this is the least concrete field, but it still clearly distinguishes Neptune's uncertain ideal from the Node's practice-led direction.
